Support that never makes a customer repeat themselves

I read the whole ticket first. Then I give a clear next step with a time, and I follow up until the issue is closed. Customers feel looked after, and the next agent can pick up the case without asking again.

Day to day I answer questions about tracking, delays, returns, refunds, replacements and warranty for online stores. I also review support conversations for accuracy and tone, and I help train other agents.

From that work I build what a team needs to stay consistent: tag systems, QA scorecards, handover templates, reply packs and training guides. You can open real examples below.
